replies.root_cause: TCP-MD5 authentication key mismatch: the local key was rotated in commit CHG-31120 (09:31 UTC) but the customer still uses the old key, so the kernel drops their segments ('tcp_auth_ok ... wrong MD5 digest') and the session cannot establish. Fix: coordinate the key with the customer (or roll back the key change).
